blocks.instruction: Rest both hands; check that both gloves, the green cup and the red marker fixed to the jar body (not the lid) remain in view.
Separate right- then left-hand cup grasps; pause at rest between attempts.
Left hand holds jar; right hand approaches and grasps cup. Keep the sequential two-hand case.
Swap hands: right holds jar; left approaches and grasps cup.
Contact without requesting grasp; hover, hesitate and withdraw; include rest pauses.
Both hands approach together, then one grasps while the other makes an unrelated movement.
Brief natural hand crossing, small head turn and hand disappearance/reappearance.
Finish at rest with both hands visible.
